subject.title: fix(memory-core): guard catch-block async calls and supplement search against unhandled rejections

question: When every registered corpus supplement rejects, should corpus=all return an unavailable result or return healthy local-memory results with an explicit supplement warning?
rationale: Corpus supplements are a public plugin seam, and this choice determines whether a complete supplement outage suppresses otherwise healthy local retrieval; the repository has no established documented contract for that combination.

options.title: Preserve local retrieval
options.body: Return successful local-memory results with a structured warning that all requested supplements failed.

options.title: Return unavailable
options.body: Treat total supplement failure as failure of the complete corpus=all request even when local memory completed successfully.

recommendation.title: Preserve local retrieval
recommendation.body: Return successful local-memory results with a structured warning that all requested supplements failed.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the corpus bridge and are the strongest available history owner for its combined-source failure contract.
